machine.note: This is the host that invoked the runner. GitHub `ubuntu-latest` / `macos-latest` weekly cron is not a named fixed benchmark machine (Issue #8 §8.2 / #12).

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_shapes_nothing
invariants.note: The Runtime measured no text node again: nothing about what any label says changed.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_lays_out_nothing
invariants.note: No paragraph was laid out again, by the Runtime or by the painter.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_paint_lays_out_nothing
invariants.note: The painter drew every label from a layout it already held.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_rasterizes_nothing
invariants.note: No glyph bitmap was produced: the labels move by whole device pixels, at the sub-pixel bins they were rasterized for.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_uploads_no_atlas_region
invariants.note: No atlas region reached the GPU.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_rebuilds_no_entry
invariants.note: Every label was answered by its retained entry: the painter snaps the slide to whole device pixels, so no label's sub-pixel phase changed and none was resolved again (#223).

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_uploads_no_instance
invariants.note: No instance byte reached the GPU: a whole-pixel move rewrites the one presentation row the labels share, not their runs or glyphs.

invariants.name: text_compositor_slide_answers_nodes_from_entries
invariants.note: Nodes that reached a draw without resolving a glyph. Missing stays not-evaluable and must never be read as 0.

scenario.notes: Issue #223 sub-pixel gate. The list holding a thousand labels slides sideways by 0.37 px a frame, the way a trackpad scrolls, so its translation is almost never a whole pixel. The painter draws a pure translation on whole device pixels while the Runtime keeps the fraction; the labels keep their sub-pixel phase and every one is answered by its retained entry: no shape, no layout, no raster, no atlas upload, no instance rebuild or upload. Work counters are the gate; the timings are host observation. Not Issue #8 weekly DoD and has no Iced/GPUI analog.

mapping_notes: Loaded perf/scenarios/gpu-scene-text-compositor-slide.json and materialized its UiOnly params (viewport, host_texture slot, ui_nodes, node_repeat).
RuntimeDocument flush + HostTexture content slot + SceneWgpuPainter encode/submit. Not a private hosted-gpu-demo tree. No CPU readback.
gpu_upload_bytes counts observed queue.write_buffer on that path. NanaRenderer::text atlas uploads are reported separately as glyph_upload_bytes, not estimated into this one.
Batch / GpuUpload / Encode / Submit are FrameProfiler status=ran on the same encode/submit. Runtime-only drains keep those stages unsupported and omit GPU keys.
text_counters are per sampled frame: what one frame asked the retained-text path to resolve, rebuild and upload again.
